calls.title: Ashley / Lyndsie - DG Role
calls.summary: The team discussed ongoing challenges in finding a suitable candidate for the Director of Growth position, noting that none of the interviewed candidates felt like a strong fit. Lyndsie Berens expressed her concerns about aligning her expectations with the current market conditions influenced by layoffs, emphasizing the importance of taking time to find the right fit. Ashley Stirrup shared insights on using AI tools to enhance email personalization, while the cultural fit and execution expectations were stressed as critical factors in hiring.
